## About
Nash's Automotive is a full service repair shop on W Main St in Allen, Texas. We handle everything from routine maintenance like tune-ups and oil changes to brakes, suspension, A.C. repair and engine work, on both foreign and domestic vehicles.
If you are not sure what is wrong, bring it in and we can run a diagnostic engine check. Our technicians are ASE-certified, and the shop is certified by AAA and approved by the Better Business Bureau.
Customers have given us a 4.4 rating from 80 Google reviews. One reviewer thanked Tim and Bess by name, and another said the shop explained an unexpected issue clearly and without technical jargon.

## Services
- Diagnostic engine check: Not sure what the problem is? Come see us and we will help track it down.
- Brakes, suspension and oil changes: Everyday repair and upkeep to keep your car stopping and riding the way it should.
- Tune-up service: Routine tune-ups to keep your engine running right.
- Engine replacement: Engine repair and replacement when the problem goes deeper.
- A.C. repair: Repair for your car's air conditioning.
- Factory recommended maintenance: Scheduled maintenance at the intervals your vehicle's maker recommends.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We service both foreign and domestic vehicles, and we carry the specialty parts your vehicle may need.

Q: Can you tow my car to the shop?
A: Yes, towing is available within a 15-mile radius. Give us a call and we will arrange it.

Q: Can I get a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: We offer a complimentary ride within a 1-mile radius.
